title: 第19章 魔纹，她知道！？
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
“对啊师兄，咱们这些天一直在正道联盟找，怎么就没想到问问魔门的人呢？说不定这事儿在他们眼里都不是什么秘密！”

    林天也是一拍手掌。

    “不行，我等不及了，现在我就要发布悬赏令，我王家出的起这个价！”

    王峰说着，头也不回的就走了出去。

    “那个该死的妖人，别让我知道是谁，否则，我非要把他碎尸万段！！”

    ……

    林天和陆沉一脸无语。

    随后，林天又看到了魅姬。

    “诶师兄，魅姬她不就是现成的魔门核心嘛！这事儿让她去问问不就好了！”

    “是吗……”

    魅姬拖长了尾音，目光若有若无地扫过陆沉，后者心里咯噔一下。

    “我宗门这边也不知道呢，不然，我也就不问林郎你了。”

    “也是。”

    听到魅姬的回答，林天又坐了下去。

    “我，那我去帮帮王师兄，林师兄你和嫂子聊就行。”

    感受到魅姬意味深长的眼神，陆沉有些心神不宁，打算找个借口离开。

    “别啊陆沉弟弟，咱们是第一次见面，嫂嫂多少也得给你个见面礼不是？”

    魅姬笑盈盈的拦住了陆沉。

    “咳咳，不用不用，林师兄和庄静白嫂子，已经给过我增加词条的宝物了，你就不用给了。”

    此话一出，林天的后背瞬间被冷汗浸湿。

    庄静白和魅姬都是醋包中的醋包，陆沉提这么一嘴庄静白，这是要他死啊！

    他自问待陆沉也不薄，但是他37度的嘴，怎么可以说出这么冰冷的话？

    殊不知，这是陆沉故意为之。

    看过原文的他当然知道女主的性格，甚至在早期阶段，书里的女主疯了一样的明争暗斗，大打出手，让林天头疼不已，却又无可奈何。

    她们的掐架甚至可以持续到书的后期，直到主角林天修炼登顶，莫名出现的王霸之气，才让女主们不吵架。

    总之这书后期崩了，逻辑方面烂尾。

    但这也足够了，陆沉就吃女主的性格，包会让自己走，然后制裁林天的。

    果不其然，再听到陆沉的话后，魅姬脸上的笑容瞬间消失，冷冷的瞪了林天一眼。

    但是她依然没有让陆沉走。

    她自然看穿了陆沉的小把戏，这烂水平。就别在她这魔女面前搞智斗了。
content_en:
"Yes, senior brother, we have been looking for it in the Righteous Alliance these days, why didn't we think of asking the people from the Demon Sect? Maybe this matter is not a secret in their eyes!"

Lin Tian also clapped his hands.

"No, I can't wait any longer. I'm going to issue a reward order now. My Wang family can afford this price!"

Wang Feng said and walked out without looking back.

"Don't let me know who that damn monster is, otherwise, I will cut him into pieces!!"

…

Lin Tian and Lu Chen were speechless.

Later, Lin Tian saw Mei Ji again.

"Hey, senior brother, isn't Mei Ji the ready-made core of the Demon Sect! Why don't we just ask her about this matter!"

"Really..."

Mei Ji protracted her voice and glanced at Lu Chen vaguely, making the latter's heart skip a beat.

"My sect doesn't know either. Otherwise, I wouldn't ask you, Lin Lang."

"Same."

After hearing Mei Ji's answer, Lin Tian sat down again.

"I, then I will go and help Senior Brother Wang. Senior Brother Lin, just talk to your sister-in-law."

Feeling Mei Ji's meaningful look, Lu Chen felt a little uneasy and planned to find an excuse to leave.

"No, brother Lu Chen, this is the first time we've met, so my sister-in-law has to give you some kind of meeting gift, right?"

Mei Ji stopped Lu Chen with a smile.

"Ahem, no, no, no, no, no, no, senior brother Lin and sister-in-law Zhuang Jingbai have already given me the treasures to add entries, so you don't need to give them to me."

As soon as these words came out, Lin Tian's back was instantly soaked with cold sweat.

Zhuang Jingbai and Mei Ji are both jealous of each other. Lu Chenti said Zhuang Jingbai was going to die!

He asked himself that he treated Lu Chen well, but how could his 37-degree mouth say such cold words?

As everyone knows, this was Lu Chen's deliberate move.

Having read the original text, he certainly knew the character of the heroine. Even in the early stages, the heroine in the book fought openly and secretly like crazy and fought violently, which gave Lin Tian a headache, but he was helpless.

Their fight can even continue until the later part of the book, until the protagonist Lin Tian reaches the top of his cultivation, and the inexplicable appearance of a domineering spirit prevents the heroines from quarreling.

In short, the book fell apart in the later stage, and the logic was unfinished.

But this is enough. Lu Chen will take advantage of the heroine's character, Bao will let him go, and then punish Lin Tian.

Sure enough, after hearing Lu Chen's words again, the smile on Mei Ji's face disappeared instantly and she gave Lin Tian a cold look.

But she still didn't let Lu Chen go.

She naturally saw through Lu Chen's little tricks, this level of badness.Just don't engage in a battle of wits in front of a witch like her.
